projectDescription: A browser-based unblocked entertainment hub featuring hundreds of games, movies, music, and websites accessible from any network.
keyFeatures: Hundreds of unblocked browser games playable without installation
Featured games including 3Dash, Slope, Polytrack, and Roblox
All-games library with alphabetical search and filtering
XP & leveling system that rewards play time with avatar unlocks
Pin up to 3 favorite games for quick access
Disguise Site mode to change the tab title and favicon
Hide Site mode to overlay a decoy webpage
Dark mode with persistent localStorage preference
Collapsible sidebar with live clock widget
publicApiSurface: games/games.html — main games hub with grid of featured games
games/more-games.html — full all-games library with XP, pinning, recently-played, search
games/polytrack — Polytrack racing game (to be added as local .html)
movies-shows/movies-shows.html — movies and TV shows section
localStorage: sidebarClosed — persists sidebar open/close state
localStorage: astro_level / astro_xp — persists XP and level
localStorage: astro_recent — persists recently played games (last 5)
localStorage: astro_settings — disguise title, favicon, hide URL
